steps.title: Isolate plasma from whole blood
steps.instruction: Isolate plasma using either a dual centrifugation method or a prolonged single centrifugation method.

substeps.instruction: Dual Centrifugation: Centrifuge 10 mL of EDTA anticoagulated whole blood at 3000 g for 15 minutes (acceleration 5, brake 6, temperature 18 °C) using a Hettich centrifuge (4706-01, Rotina 420R).
Transfer plasma phase to a new tube, leaving approximately 1 mL of plasma on top of the buffy coat.
Centrifuge again at 3000 g for 15 minutes (acceleration 5, brake 6, temperature 18 °C).
Transfer plasma phase to cryo tubes, leaving approximately 1 mL of plasma in the bottom of the tube and store at -80 °C.
Alternative Single Centrifugation: Centrifuge 5 mL of EDTA anticoagulated whole blood at 3000 g for 30 minutes (acceleration 5, brake 6, temperature 18 °C).
Transfer plasma phase to cryo-tubes, leaving approximately 0.5 mL of plasma on top of the buffy coat.

steps.title: Prepare RT master mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Reverse Transcription (RT) master mix, adding 10-20% excess volume. Mix gently and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Include an RT-negative sample (no template).
Include an RT-positive sample (a microRNA-sample included in all runs).

steps.title: Set up RT reactions
steps.instruction: Combine the master mix and purified microRNA for each reaction.

substeps.instruction: Combine 7 µL RT master mix with 3 µL of purified microRNA in a 0.2 µL polypropylene reaction tube.
Keep on ice, mix gently, and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Perform RT incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction tubes in a thermocycler using the specified cycling conditions.

substeps.instruction: Run 40 cycles of: 16 °C for 2 min, 42 °C for 1 min, and 50 °C for 1 sec.
Finish with 85 °C for 5 min and cool to 4 ºC.

steps.title: Store or proceed with cDNA
steps.instruction: Continue immediately to PCR amplification or store the RT-reaction at -20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare preamplification reaction mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the preamplification reaction mix, adding 10-20% excess volume, and mix gently.

steps.title: Perform preamplification
steps.instruction: Combine the preamplification mix with cDNA and incubate in a 96 well plate.

substeps.instruction: Combine 20 µL of qPCR reaction mix with 5 µL of RT-reaction (cDNA) in a 96 well plate and seal the plate.
Incubate at 95 °C for 10 min, 55 °C for 2 min, and 72 °C for 2 min.
Perform 14 cycles of 95 °C for 15 sec and 60 °C for 4 min.
Finish with 99.9 °C for 10 min and cool to 4 °C.

steps.title: Store preamplified cDNA
steps.instruction: Continue immediately or store at 4 °C for up to 12 hours or at -20 °C for up to 1 week.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the qPCR reaction mix (run each sample in doublets), adding 10-20% excess volume and mixing gently.

steps.title: Set up qPCR reactions
steps.instruction: Combine the qPCR mix and cDNA in a 96 well plate and seal the plate.

substeps.instruction: Combine 19 µL of qPCR reaction mix with 1.3 µL of RT-reaction (cDNA).

steps.title: Load TLDA array
steps.instruction: Load the sample-dilutions into the array and seal.

substeps.instruction: Load 100 µL sample-dilution to each port on the array.
Centrifuge the array at 1200 rpm for 2 min.
Seal the array.

steps.title: Normalize data
steps.instruction: Perform normalization using the ΔCt-method: 2^(-ΔCt), where ΔCt = mean Ct target miRNA - mean Ct cel-miR-39 (mean of triplets).

description: Follow the instructions given by the manufacture (se notes before you start): a STEP 1: use 300 µL platelet-poor plasma STEP 4: after addition of isopropanol, add also 5 µL spike-in (cel-miR-39, 2.75 × 10 −12 M) STEP 6: perform the optional DNA digest
